text:
Type: nickel table lamp with fabric shade
Use: reading and mood light on a side table, nightstand or desk; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: classic, contemporary, traditional
Materials: nickel-plated metal stem and ring base, white fabric shade, pull-cord switch
Colors: white, brushed silver nickel
Shape: tapered empire shade on a slim adjustable stem, open ring-shaped base with a crossbar, small pull cord, medium height, light visual weight
Feel: elegant, calm, homey, timeless
Goes with: dark or light wood, white or grey walls, silver accents; classic, traditional or contemporary bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: NYFORS
product.description: You can create a soft, cosy atmosphere in your home with a textile shade that spreads a diffused and decorative light.
